concerns.text: The plan specifies a **paired‑bootstrap hypothesis test** between 1 ns and 10 ns MAE (FR‑008, SC‑005) but only generates a single 10 ns trajectory (1 seed). Bootstrapping a single observation yields a degenerate distribution with zero variance, making the resulting p‑value and confidence interval mathematically meaningless. This violates the statistical requirement for a valid paired‑bootstrap test and undermines SC‑005’s claim of reporting a meaningful p‑value.
